# The four-row shape

`four-active.json` is the shape of the capture that started the output
redesign: four active work items, two states, two projects, titles long enough
that a one-line row has to elide them, and three of the four refusing to open
for the same reason. Its content is synthetic - the same lengths and the same
punctuation, none of the fleet it was taken from - because a fixture in this
repository carries no real data, which is the rule `fixtures/README.md` states
for the web panel's own sets.

What it is for is the layout: at 120 columns every column has to line up under
its heading, and at 48 the selection, the state and what Enter will do have to
survive when the title no longer can.
